guidance.name: go-api-contracts
guidance.reason: Refresh is an exported API with a specified file representation and retention contract. Preserve the exact existing function type, Item representation, Write behavior, module path, and Go 1.22 minimum.

guidance.name: go-behavior-tests
guidance.reason: The task implements meaningful remote snapshot behavior and explicitly requests high-quality regression tests. Use independent byte oracles, last-accepted-state checks, actual partial-write failure, and a controlled direct-write counterexample.

guidance.name: go-core-style
guidance.reason: The task writes production and test Go code. Use standard-library dependencies, immediate error handling, explicit resource ownership, and gofmt/vet/race checks.

guidance.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
guidance.reason: Refresh starts using the supplied concrete HTTP client/context and acquires response bodies and temporary files. Keep the public concrete dependency and local resource ownership without new production interfaces.

guidance.name: go-package-boundaries
guidance.reason: Remote acquisition adds a responsibility to the existing snapshot operation. Keep it in the existing mirror package because the requested Refresh facade owns validation and publication and no separate consumer or independently maintained adapter is demonstrated.

unopened_optional_references.reason: No package split or alternative project shape was needed.
